title: Wholesome Flaky Double-rise-bread Pilaf
description: A grassy, flaky Algerian dish featuring white chocolate chips and double-rise bread in one pot. A no-onion-no-garlic-friendly dessert option.

ingredients.name: 2 cups double-risen bread
ingredients.notes: Make sure the bread has been fully risen and cooled

ingredients.name: 1 cup white chocolate chips
ingredients.notes: Optional, for added texture and flavor

instructions: In a baking dish, layer the cooled double-risen bread evenly.
Sprinkle white chocolate chips over the top if using.
Evenly distribute the grated lemon zest and cinnamon on top of the bread.
Bake for 20 minutes or until the top is golden brown.
Serve warm as a dessert option.
Enjoy your Wholesome Flaky Double-rise-bread Pilaf!
